programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    zeros = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(g) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in zeros), max(r for r, c in zeros)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in zeros), max(c for r, c in zeros)
    # The colored pattern is the non-background, non-zero rectangle.
    bg = max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(g) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0, bg)]
    sr0, sr1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    sc0, sc1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    h, w = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
    for dr in range(h):
        for dc in range(w):
            g[r0+dr][c0+dc] = g[sr0+dr][sc1-dc]
    return g
'''
